charts.name: Plano Geral de Contabilidade (PGC) — selecção para sociedades comerciais
charts.legal_reference: Decreto n.º 82/01, de 16 de novembro, approves the Plano Geral de Contabilidade, the legal chart of accounts of Angola. It applies to companies other than banks and insurers, which follow their own regimes (the International Financial Reporting Standards for banks); the IFRS complement the plan. The chart carries the official codes and names of classes 1 to 8, with the dots removed from each code (34.5.3.1 is 34531), at the level of detail a trading company posts to. The VAT sub-accounts of account 34.5 come from Decreto Presidencial n.º 180/19, de 24 de maio. Where this pack adds a level the plan leaves free, it says so in the name or in the README: 7581 Arredondamentos (rounding) and 3791 IVA de importação a pagar à alfândega (import VAT owed to customs).

numbering.legal_reference: Decreto Presidencial n.º 71/25, art. 10.º, n.º 1, alínea b) — an invoice carries a sequential and chronological number by type of document and economic year, in one or more identified series. The style is `sequential` and the number restarts each year, as the format carries the year.

tax_point.legal_reference: Código do IVA (Lei n.º 7/19, as republished by the Lei n.º 14/23), art. 11.º — the tax is due and chargeable when the goods are placed at the disposal of the buyer or when the service is performed; for continuous supplies with periodic payments, at the end of each period. `delivery_date` is the closest value of Ekwo's vocabulary; the special rules on advances, which the Modelo 7 reports in field 41, are not modelled and are recorded in the README.

einvoicing.legal_reference: Angola has no Peppol authority, no published structured-invoice profile and no ISO 6523 scheme a party is addressed by, so `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null and `obligation` is `none`. What Angola has instead is a clearance-style system: Decreto Presidencial n.º 71/25, art. 16.º, makes electronic invoicing mandatory for taxpayers of the general and simplified VAT regimes; art. 17.º requires invoicing software validated or provided by the Administração Geral Tributária (AGT) that transmits each invoice to it in real time; art. 37.º phases the obligation in — large taxpayers and suppliers of the State first, from 1 January 2026, then every taxpayer subject to it, from 1 January 2027 as the tax administration announced. That is a real-time reporting of each invoice to the tax administration, not a peer-to-peer exchange between businesses in the sense `einvoicing.profile` describes. Ekwo does not connect to the AGT platform; the gap is recorded in docs/international.md and in this pack's README.
